name: High School Equivalency (HSE) Diplomas Awarded to NYCHA Residents by NYCHA Development – Local Law 163
description: This dataset reports the number of High School Equivalency (HSE) diplomas awarded to New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) residents, broken down by year and by NYCHA development, as required under Local Law 163. It covers years 2018 through 2024 and includes roughly 500 distinct developments. Each row lists a year, a development name, and the count of diplomas awarded there; small counts are suppressed and shown as "< 5" (or "<5"), which applies to the large majority of records. The data can be used to track HSE attainment over time, compare outcomes across developments, identify areas with lower educational attainment, and inform policy or program evaluation for resident education services. Users should note that suppressed small counts limit precise totals and that comparisons across developments should account for differences in population size.
